subject: afi
title: AFI.------(R)PART.OR.POST.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-6 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the principal interest in black postulation dynamics … developed as a result of the composite projectional spread of black creative invention in the last three thousand years.' (C)AFI (the concept of affinity insight) is crossed with (R)PART-OR-POST (the reality of participation OR postulation): the question is what affinity-insight produces when crossed with the disjunctive partner participation-or-postulation — the disjunction itself is load-bearing. SI (source initiation) anchors the upper-right output. COS-ASN (cosmic assignment) sits between subject and partner. OP-SPD (option-spread) anchors the right margin. PRI-INFO (principle information) also sits on the path between subject and partner, after COS-ASN. SI rises from the stretch between PRI-INFO and the partner and carries OP-SPD. AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) hangs on the lower-center via a *dashed* edge from that same stretch — a dotted line that, in Braxton's legend, 'amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to'. (R)PART-OR-POST itself is the disjunctive partner. Structural argument: affinity-insight crossed with the disjunctive participation-or-postulation is mediated by cosmic-assignment and then principle-information.
